selection_rationale: Chooses the head-to-head verifier comparison because it targets an operationally meaningful, falsifiable question about safety of LLM→configuration pipelines, maps directly to identified literature gaps (G2/Q1), is highly relevant to the CNSM Agentic-AI track, and yields clear paired, executable outcomes amenable to the five-page short paper after the listed repairs.
unresolved_uncertainties: Digital-twin/emulator fidelity vs production vendor idiosyncrasies (impact on external validity).
Availability and licensing of representative multi-vendor images for the planned intent set.
Prompt sensitivity and whether prompt/repair-loop choices will dominate observed differences between verifiers.
Engineering parity across verifier implementations (functional feature and performance differences may bias results).
Required sample size (N) to obtain narrow CIs given per-intent variance and compute budget constraints.
Exact operational definition and labeling policy for a "harmful misconfiguration" (connectivity-preservation vs policy/regression distinctions).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Pre-register a power calculation and, if full N=300 is infeasible, a stratified reduced intent set with rationale and sampling plan.
Specify exact verifier implementations, versions, and a documented engineering-parity checklist (APIs, resource limits, timeout policies, language bindings).
Freeze and publish fixed prompt templates, seeds, and a prompt-sensitivity ablation plan (pre-registered perturbations and analysis).
Declare emulator/emulation software, vendor-image versions, and image hashes; pre-validate and document key vendor-behavior gaps and expected impacts on results.
Pre-register precise harm-labeling rules (binary and graded), connectivity/regression tests, and the paired comparison statistical plan (McNemar test details, CI method).
Document compute/time budget and fallback sampling plan if emulation capacity is exceeded; include reproducible harness and versioned code to ensure parity.
